chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Hammad ibn 'Uthman from 'Abd al-Hamid ibn 'Awwaz said:

I heard Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'When the soul of one of you reaches this (point), it is said to him: As for what you were cautious of from the worries of the world and its grief, so you are safe from it'; and it is said to him: 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and 'Ali (peace be upon him) and Fatima (peace be upon her) are in front of you'.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the soul at death according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on the visions of the believer and disbeliever, this hadith highlights the spiritual relief (amn) from worldly anxieties as the soul transitions into the barzakh. It emphasizes the intercessory presence of the Ahl al-Bayt, specifically greeting the deceased with the Prophet, Imam Ali, and Fatima, reflecting the Shia belief in their role as spiritual guides even in the grave.

en.hubeali: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Abdul Hameed Bin Awwaz who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘When a soul of one of you reaches this (point), it is said to him: ‘As for what you were cautious of from the worries of the world and its grief, so you are safe from it’; and it is said to him: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and Ali<sup>asws</sup> and Fatima<sup>asws</sup> are in front of you’.
en.sarwar: 10. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu Nasr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn ‘Awwad who has said the following:

“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘When the soul of any one of you reaches this point, he is told, “You are now safe from the anxiety and sadness of the worldly matters.’” It is also said to him, ‘The Messenger of Allah, Ali and Fatimah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, are in front of you.’”
